name: doe-testbed
description: Physics-grounded engineering test problems and benchmark pipeline for design-of-experiments method evaluation. The headline Communications Engineering protocol uses 34 fixed cases, 20 nature_pool methods, budgets {5, 10, 20, 50}, 30 repeats, paired case-repeat seeds, streamed row-level results, and generated paper figdata/numbers/SI artifacts.
runtimePlatform: Linux server for full benchmark pipeline
Windows workstation for smoke, unit, physics, and preflight tests
